steps.title: Step 1 — Play the story, and side content as it shows up
steps.text: Play through the five chapters (91 missions) and take on optional missions and character quests as they appear, since many are only offered for a while. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies land here in order, starting with Gone Fishing. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go — 200 vehicle scans and 100 animal studies are needed later — and turn on every progress and collectible notification in the settings.
points: Chapter trophies pop as the next chapter begins, not at the final mission itself.
Do optional missions and character questlines as they appear; several are only offered for a while.
Scan vehicles and study animals from the start — the counts add up.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: 15 manual slots, no mission replay, no New Game Plus.

steps.title: Step 2 — Finish the 100% checklist
steps.text: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work through what is left. The story alone is worth 50% of the total; Tasks 27%, Exploration & Activities 20%, Discovery 3%. Most items need only part of a set. The ones that need everything: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all drone races, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. A Long Road, the gold 100% trophy, is the last big gate and the hardest trophy by both guides' judgement.
points: Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be finished in free roam after the story.
Robberies first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 vaults.
Then the grind trophies: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans.
Fencing totals: $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills, $200,000 vehicles.

steps.title: Step 3 — Strangers & Freaks and clean-up
steps.text: Stranger missions are not part of the 100% checklist, so they are finished here: 8 qualifying stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks, along with any character questlines still open and any miscellaneous trophies left over. Everything in this step stays available in free roam after the story.
points: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward the 8 strands; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not.
The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed — check the trophy counter in-game.
Five trophies have no confirmed method yet; check the Missables tab before chasing them.

hundred.name: Story missions
hundred.note: Complete every main mission until the credits roll. Worth half the total on its own.

hundred.name: Optional tasks
hundred.note: Optional missions and side quests. A handful are missable during the story, but there are a few hundred, so 100 comes easily.

hundred.name: Gang operations cleared
hundred.note: Rob every illegal operation for all 9 gangs. Loot every key valuable on the first visit; respawns take a long time.

hundred.name: Bank jobs
hundred.note: Unlock after Credit Check in Chapter 3. Small banks need the cash drawer and the safe; large banks add a vault.

hundred.name: Payday loan jobs
hundred.note: Unlock with bank jobs after Credit Check. Point a gun at the teller, take the counter cash, then the back-room safe.

hundred.name: Smash 'N' Grabs
hundred.note: Pawn shops (from Chapter 2, after Coffee Break) and jewelry stores (from Chapter 3, after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Always loot the back-room safe.

hundred.name: Stick ups
hundred.note: Quick robberies of smaller shops. 50 different stores out of the 91 tracked on the map.

hundred.name: Narcotics fenced
hundred.note: Found at gang operations and inside cocaine flamingos. Sell to any fence.

hundred.name: Jewelry fenced
hundred.note: Comes from robbing jewelry stores. Robbing every store gets you there.

hundred.name: Marked bills fenced
hundred.note: Needs the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check. One large bank vault can hold over $200,000.

hundred.name: Bank vaults hit
hundred.note: Unlock with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van, wait for the guard, break in while the vault is open.

hundred.name: Vehicles fenced
hundred.note: Unlock in Chapter 2 with Moses. Randy's Wish List sports cars pay $35,000 or more in perfect condition.

hundred.name: Kenton sets
hundred.note: Treasure from Kenton's 7 shipwrecks. All 7 are needed for the underwater discoveries below.

hundred.name: Collectible card sets
hundred.note: 480 cards across 18 sets. Track them under Progress, then Collections.

hundred.name: WAiNK locations scanned
hundred.note: Landmarks, sculptures and other sights, scanned with the WAiNK phone app.

hundred.name: Underwater discoveries
hundred.note: The sunken shipwrecks from Kenton's treasure quests; all 7 of his sets cover this.

hundred.name: Magazines, books & comics
hundred.note: Only unique ones count. 27 magazines, books and comics plus 7 book swaps.

hundred.name: Meditation spots
hundred.note: 10 locations; meditating with both characters together counts twice, for 18 in total.

hundred.name: Cocaine flamingos destroyed
hundred.note: Pink flamingo ornaments with a black and white beak. They drop a hidden package of cocaine.

hundred.name: Unique playlists
hundred.note: Unlocked by scanning specific posters, which adds new music playlists.

hundred.name: Discovered styles
hundred.note: Magazine tattoos (scanned with WAiNK) plus 34 luxury watches, usually found at gang operations.

hundred.name: Unique races won
hundred.note: Blue map icons. The trophy Earn Cash, Not Kudos needs only 20.

hundred.name: Race challenge gold medals
hundred.note: Get gold in the 10 race challenges you find easiest.

hundred.name: Shooting range gold medals
hundred.note: Griffin Shooting Range (18) and Rodgers Ranch (24). Buy a $5 Waiver Pass at each store first.

hundred.name: Video games played
hundred.note: Three on the home TV, Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets. Starting each one is enough.

hundred.name: Pool opponents defeated
hundred.note: Beat any 5 of the 7 pool opponents.

hundred.name: Mini golf locations played
hundred.note: Play at any 2 of the 3 mini golf locations.

hundred.name: Basketball hoops
hundred.note: Sink baskets at 90 of the 100 hoops.

hundred.name: Drone time trials
hundred.note: All 42 drone races. The Top Fun trophy needs one win at each of the 14 locations.

hundred.name: Stunts
hundred.note: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.

hundred.name: Challenges
hundred.note: Eight categories of 10. The trophy One Last Thing needs only 50.

hundred.name: Bret's Target Decks
hundred.note: Hunt the animals on Bret's decks and bring them back as Jason.

hundred.name: Base model vehicles scanned
hundred.note: Scan every new vehicle with WAiNK, including boats and aircraft. The trophy needs only 100.

hundred.name: Standard issue weapons found
hundred.note: Find any 50 of the 66 standard issue weapons.

hundred.name: Animals studied
hundred.note: Study animals through the binoculars as you go. No hunting or skinning needed.
